name: What are the signs of a slow-draining bathtub that indicate a problem?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of a slow-draining bathtub that indicate a problem?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs of a slow-draining bathtub that indicate a problem include water pooling around your feet while showering, slower than usual drainage after a bath, gurgling sounds coming from the drain, or a foul odor emanating from the drain. These symptoms suggest a partial clog is forming and water flow is restricted. Addressing these early warning signs promptly can prevent the clog from becoming a complete blockage, which can be more difficult and costly to resolve. Early detection allows for simpler repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs of a slow-draining bathtub include pooling water, slow drainage, gurgling, or odors, indicating a partial clog.
